premise_falsified.old_next_gate: measure per-example oracle headroom from existing sweeps
premise_falsified.why_wrong: The T21 sweep (Qwen3-32B x variable_tracking x resume_j in {3,6,13,20,27,34,41,48} x {16k,32k}, n=50/cell) does NOT use the same 50 samples across configs. Measured on zwfy6 by md5-ing the full question text and the target column: j3 INTERSECT j6 = 0/50, j3 INTERSECT j13 = 0/50, ... j3 INTERSECT j48 = 0/50. Target column intersections are also 0/50. RULER variable_tracking is synthesised at eval time and the sample identity was never fixed or seeded per config.
premise_falsified.consequence: per-example oracle requires the SAME example measured under different configs, to compute oracle = max_config(quality) and regret = oracle - best_fixed_config. With disjoint sample sets neither quantity is computable. Only cell-level 'best fixed config' can be computed -- which is precisely the baseline the oracle is supposed to beat, not the oracle.
